title: feat: add Gemini 3.5 Transcribe with Vertex and OpenRouter fallback
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15843

- Adds paid-only `google/gemini-3.5-transcribe` with Vertex global `gemini-3.5-transcribe-preview` primary and OpenRouter fallback. No aliases; multiplier 1; no Pollinations GPU. OpenRouter manages its transcription backend selection.
- Supports seven audio formats and json/text/verbose_json/diarized_json, including word timestamps and speaker labels. `prompt` is ignored; duration is approximate (reported audio tokens / 25).
- Bills reported usage at [Vertex's published rates](https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/generative-ai/pricing): $2/M audio input and $12/M text output. Fallback costs include OpenRouter's 5.5% fee; customer rates do not. Vertex's extra timestamp-related input text tokens remain recorded at zero pending clarification of their unpublished rate. OpenRouter currently reports zero output tokens; no official explanation was found.
- Rejects text-valued and empty uploads with 400 responses. Preserves contributor history and updates the branch from main.
- Verified: 99 focused/regression tests, pricing snapshot, Gen typecheck and formatting. Authenticated real-provider E2E passed Vertex and forced OpenRouter fallback, all formats/outputs, access errors, three concurrent requests, disconnect/rejoin and cached replay. Each generation produced one wallet debit and one staging billed event. Sample fallback: customer 0.000628 Pollen, cost 0.00066254 Pollen.

gist.headline: The hive takes notes
gist.blurb: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe can now turn audio into text, with word timestamps and speaker labels when you need the details. Vertex takes the first listen; OpenRouter is there if it needs a hand.
gist.summary: Added paid-only `google/gemini-3.5-transcribe`, using Vertex's `gemini-3.5-transcribe-preview` with OpenRouter fallback, seven audio formats, and four output formats including word timestamps and speaker labels.
gist.impact: Developers can request plain text, JSON, verbose JSON, or diarized JSON transcripts; customer usage is billed at $2 per million audio input tokens and $12 per million text output tokens.
gist.visual_concept: Depict spoken audio becoming a readable transcript in a cozy garden workspace: Polli listens with tiny headphones while the monitor robot displays timestamped words and speaker labels. Two gently branching paths marked Vertex and OpenRouter represent the primary provider and fallback.
